description: Phase 3 (#55) v0.3.1 evaluation corpus. Seventeen fixtures: 15 v0.3.0 fixtures covering the full 5-workstream x 3-class matrix (#55a) + 2 v0.3.1 fixtures exercising the safety counter instrumentation surface (#55b). The v0.3.1 additions are dimension=E (safety_resilience) positive counter assertions: safety-secret-leak-v1 verifies the SessionService.ingest hook records one secret_leak_count per secret-bearing event, safety-injection-blocked-v1 verifies the prompt-injection hook records one injection_bypass_count per pattern-matched event.
